summary: A Yes vote enacts a 1% transactions and use (sales) tax in the City of San Clemente to fund natural hazard purposes such as beach restoration and wildfire prevention.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports a 1% sales tax increase to fund beach protection and fire prevention services.
tax.quote: A “Yes” vote is a vote in favor of the tax.

tax.text: The Measure M opposition urged voters to reject a 1% sales-tax increase for beach protection and wildfire programs, calling it too large and poorly structured.
tax.quote: We all love our beaches. We all want fire safety. But this 1% tax hike is too large, poorly structured, and the wrong approach at a difficult time for many families.
